author: Coaspe
description: Develop, test, analyze, and operate SAP ABAP systems through ADT from AI coding agents.
name: SAP ABAP MCP

prompts.name: sap-change-object
prompts.title: Change and Verify ABAP Object
prompts.description: Guide a scoped source change through impact review, diagnostics, activation, ABAP Unit and ATC.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Exact existing ABAP object name to change

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Desired outcome and constraints, in your preferred language

prompts.name: sap-explain-object
prompts.title: Explain ABAP Object
prompts.description: Explain current SAP source and its callers with source evidence, without changing it.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Exact ABAP object name, including namespace if present

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Desired outcome and constraints, in your preferred language

prompts.name: sap-plan-rap
prompts.title: Plan RAP Service
prompts.description: Discover backend RAP capabilities and validate a generation preview without generating or publishing.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Exact RAP reference object name; include desired package and service intent in goal

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Desired outcome and constraints, in your preferred language

prompts.name: sap-review-transport
prompts.title: Assess Transport Readiness
prompts.description: Review one transport with bounded quality evidence; assessment does not release it.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Desired outcome and constraints, in your preferred language

resources.name: sap-docs-data-query
resources.title: SAP Data Query Documentation
resources.description: Safe SAP ADT data-preview SQL rules and examples.

resources.name: sap-capability-evidence
resources.title: SAP Capability Evidence
resources.description: Complete capability discovery evidence for one SAP system.

resources.name: sap-adt-source
resources.title: SAP ABAP Source
resources.description: Complete active ABAP source for one canonical ADT resource.

resources.name: sap-docs-mermaid
resources.title: Mermaid Documentation
resources.description: Bundled Mermaid syntax for one supported diagram type.

resources.name: sap-transport
resources.title: SAP Transport Evidence
resources.description: Current details and objects for one SAP transport.

tools.name: sap.capability.describe
tools.title: Describe SAP Capability
tools.description: Return the exact input schema and schema hash for one capability before invoking it.

tools.name: sap.capability.invoke_destructive
tools.title: Invoke Destructive SAP Capability
tools.description: Invoke a destructive capability after sap.capability.describe. The original tool validation and result are preserved.

tools.name: sap.capability.invoke_read
tools.title: Invoke Read SAP Capability
tools.description: Invoke a read capability after sap.capability.describe. The original tool validation and result are preserved.

tools.name: sap.capability.invoke_write
tools.title: Invoke Write SAP Capability
tools.description: Invoke a write capability after sap.capability.describe. The original tool validation and result are preserved.

tools.name: sap.capability.search
tools.title: Search SAP Capabilities
tools.description: Search or page through the complete SAP tool catalog. Use category browsing when keyword search misses.
